description: Generate the first pass of the consolidated Guests allowlist tab in the RSVP Sheet from the Invitations source: finish the official-guest-list tab setup, then explode each household into one row per known person — a stable guest_id (g001…), a shared party_id per couple, side, and plus_one_allowed (TRUE for solo invitees who may bring an unlisted Plus-one, FALSE for named couples). Unknown Plus-ones stay off the list — they are named at RSVP time. The team alerts the Team Lead once the first pass is generated. Couple review in the Sheet — correct names, party groupings, +1 flags — is the HITL gate before the tab becomes the live-authoritative source.
title: Generate the Guests allowlist tab from the Invitations tab
acceptance_criteria: A Guests tab exists in the RSVP Sheet with columns guest_id, name, party_id, side, plus_one_allowed
Every named person from the Invitations tab has exactly one row with a unique guest_id
Members of the same invitation share one party_id; named couples have plus_one_allowed FALSE, solo-with-+1 invitees have TRUE
Unknown/unnamed Plus-ones are NOT given rows
The couple has reviewed and confirmed the generated list
